'''Hrdinah''' was a [[Gender/Legends|Male]] [[Gotal/Legends|Gotal]] who was at the [[Black Dust Tavern]] on [[Socorro/Legends|Socorro]] when a bar fight erupted and he picked a fight with [[Fenig Nabon]] and was knocked unconscious in the process. After the bar fight was stopped by [[Karl Mathieu Ancher]] with his [[Calli-Merc blaster pistol]], he came to and made peace with Fenig who apoligized for his headache.<ref name="A Credit for Your Thoughts" />
